:::{#cor-cosine-similarity-angle}
#### Cosine similarity is the cosine of the angle

For nonzero vectors $\vx, \vy \in \reals^p$ with angle $\angpar$ between them (@def-angle),

$$
\cossim(\vx, \vy) = \cos\angpar.
$$

:::

::: proof

The ratio that @def-angle sets equal to $\cos\angpar$ is the ratio that @def-cosine-similarity defines as $\cossim(\vx, \vy)$.

:::
